reasoning: The native source confirms the existing CO2 detections on the steep branch and confirms additional blue open-circle markers immediately above the dense low-pressure strip and along the plateau. I added only markers whose rings are visibly separable in the unchanged source. Many further low-pressure rings are fused into a continuous blue strip and cannot be assigned reliable centers from visible pixels alone, so the extraction remains incomplete. The red N2 series and the inset are excluded.
